title: Software Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Code that saves lives.As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldA history of academic excellence or professional successEligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

title: Software Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Code that saves lives.As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldA history of academic excellence or professional successEligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

We are a highly innovative, multi-site, fast paced team developing modular and reusable software to support both our current platforms and the aircraft of the future. We operate out of the Skunk Works headquarters in Palmdale, CA in a fully onsite and hands on team.What’s In It For You3-day weekend every weekend! 4-10 Mon-Thursday option + Flexible SchedulesThis team is working new development software where our team members get to work hands on through the entire software development lifecycle from software design, coding, integrating, and lab and field testing. You will work with a talented and passionate team who is involved within the company as well as outside of the workplace. title: Senior Software Engineer (PHP & Symfony)
description: At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancerWe are professionals with purpose, beating cancer every day. But we need to go much further and much faster. Thats why were looking for someone talented, someone who wants to develop their skills, someone like you.Cancer Research UK has an ambitious Engineering Strategy and modern Tech Stack with a complex hybrid (on-premise & multi-cloud) infrastructure underpinning an extensive technical estate. As part of our Engage Strategy, the charity is delivering a range of bold, modern change initiatives and programmes to better harness our technology to deliver more engaging and positive experiences for our audiences and inspire millions of people in deeper, more meaningful ways to join our mission (and in turn drive growth).As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be part of our Fundraising & Trading portfolio, rotating across a range of change initiatives and products that helped raise 665m towards Cancer Research UK's life-saving work (e.g., our events management product, which enables mass events such as Race for Life, London Marathon, Shine, and individual events). However, you will predominantly focus on using PHP Symfony to develop the back-end of our Online Fundraising Web Application, an in-house software solution that has created half a million fundraising pages for our supporters, processed 2.6m donations, and raised c.65m for the charity. If you want to learn more about our Online Fundraising solution, check out this article from one of our Engineers working on this product.In this role, youll play a key role in advancing our Fundraising & Trading products by collaborating closely with product teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions. Youll contribute to our Engineering Strategy by writing clean, maintainable code, championing best practices, and driving technical excellence across the team.In this role, youll collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders from across the charity, including Engineers, Product Managers, Testers, Agile Coaches, Architects, and Business Analysts. Together, youll turn complex business challenges into impactful technical solutions, while continuously improving the accessibility, performance, security, and reliability of our products.Youll have the autonomy to lead the development of new features and make key technical decisions. As a senior member of the team, youll also mentor junior engineers, help shape development standards, and enhance our tooling and workflows.This is an opportunity for you to gain exposure to a modern tech stack while being part of a diverse Technology team and using your technical skills to deliver purpose-driven solutions. If youre an experienced back-end engineer with strong PHP and Symfony skills, we would love you to join our mission.What will I be doing?Delivering specific packages of development for software applications within our Fundraising & Trading Productteams andrunning these applications in production.This will involve a significant focus on the back-end creation and development of Cancer Research UKs Online Fundraising Web Application (PHP Symfony).Applying Lean and Agile principles to develop high-quality code that has minimal bugs, adheres to Cancer Research UK standards, and is highly supportable.Working either independently or in collaboration with Solution Architects to design new solutions in line with the Software Engineering strategy.Working autonomously to deliver backlog items for an existing product.Collaborating with Product Managers, Service Designers, UX Designers, Business Analysts, etc to identify user needs, discuss capabilities, and iteratively design solutions.Supporting the development of more junior Software Engineers through mentoring.What skills will I need?EssentialExperienced Software Engineer with a proven ability to write clean, readable, and properly tested code based on tried and tested design patterns.Must have demonstrable knowledge of PHP and ideally Symfony (however, were open to applicants with experience of similar PHP frameworks such as Drupal or Laravel)Some knowledge of JavaScript/ TypeScript with an ability and willingness to learn new languages, frameworks, and tools.Experience using large-scale code repositories.Some experience developing REST APIs and other back-end components.Ran critical services in production and designed highly available, scalable, and secure solutions.Awareness of accessibility standards and guidelines.Ability to communicate with technical and non-technical business colleaguesSome experience in running critical services in production and designing highly available, scalable, and secure solutions.Ideally, available to start on one months notice or less (however, were open to applicants with longer notice periods who meet all the above requirements).DesirableMeets either of the following:Acted as a Senior or Lead within an Engineering team, starting the development of new features from scratch, defining the overall solutions, and reviewing more junior engineers workSoftware Engineer with significant PHP experience who is ready for the next step up in their career, ideally with some experience in supporting and coaching colleagues and the potential to learn how to act as a Senior within the team (training will be provided if this applies).Our organisation values are designed to guide all that we do.Bold:Act with ambition, courage and determinationCredible:Act with rigour and professionalismHuman: Act to have a positive impact on peopleTogether:Act inclusively and collaborativelyWere looking for people who can believe in and embody these organisation values and can use them to drive forward progress against our mission to beat cancer.If youre interested in applying and excited about working with us but are unsure if you have the right skills and experience wed still love to hear from you.What will I gain?We create a working environment that supports your wellbeing and provide a generous benefits package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools. Our policies and processes enable you to improve your work-life balance, take positive steps in your career and achieve your personal wellbeing goals.You can explore our benefits by visiting our careers web page.Additional InformationFor more information about working with us please visit our website or contact us at .For more updates on our work and careers, follow us on: LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented.We want to see every candidate performing at their best throughout the job application process, interview process and whilst at work. We therefore ask you to inform us of any concerns you have or any adjustments you might need to enable this to happen. title: Military Operations Analyst - level 4
description: Job DescriptionYou will be a Strategic Operation Research Analyst for the Military Operations Analysis (MOA) department working Classified Programs on site in Palmdale, California. Our team is responsible for delivering engagement, mission, theater, and campaign level operations analysis across multiple classified programs for both Lockheed Martin and Department of War stakeholders. Our team primarily leverages the Advanced Framework for Modeling, Simulation, and Integration (AFSIM) software framework to develop models, apply military tactics, generate analysis, and deliver decision support material.What You Will Be DoingAs a Strategic Operation Research Analyst, you will be responsible for applying your data analytics, quantitative & qualitative reasoning coupled with warfare domain knowledge to inform both USG and LM strategic decisions within the Joint All-Domain Operations spectrum, including impact of current and future foreign threat capabilities. Your duty responsibilities will include:Creating technical AFSIM analysis, including coding, executing and summarizing AFSIM outputs and providing impartial threat-informed results to analysts and decision makers to support the Advanced Development Programs (ADP) portfolioCoordinating with classified programs within ADP and internal MOA teams in Palmdale, CA, Fort Worth, TX and other LM sites from Marietta, GAInterfacing with the MOA leadership and analysis team to ensure integration of analysis efforts and understanding of customer expectations across multiple LM Business Unit programs and portfoliosProviding excellent attention to detail within a classified environment, following security protocols and maintaining utmost care of classified data in the on-site work environment.What’s In It For YouFrom onsite to remote, we offer flexible work schedules to comprehensive benefits investing in your future and security,  Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here.Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus -if you have the passion and courage to dream big, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.You will need to be a US Citizen, and currently possess and be able to maintain a US DoD SECRET clearance, to support this government contract, as well as successfully pass a drug and background check, in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.Desired SkillsTechnical experience in radar, electronic warfare, infrared, communications, cyber, or AI.Experience modeling airborne and surface military platform, sensor, or weapon performance and joint operationsProficient in analytical methods (e.g. design of experiments, optimization, or statistical analysis)Current DoD Secret or Top Secret clearancePrior U.S. military active-duty and/or reserve experienceOther Important InformationBy applying to this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified you may be contacted for this and future openings.Ability to work remotelyOnsite Full-time: The work associated with this position will be performed onsite at a designated Lockheed Martin facility.Show moreShow less

This includes supporting, maintaining and development of the Telemetry and Radar Acquisition data Processing Systems (TRAPS), Mission Control Centers (MCC), data distribution and recording systems, Mobile Operations Facilities (MOF), Range Safety Station (RSS) and project owned Ground Control Stations (GCS). This position receives technical guidance from WGL, Field Service Engineer, and other senior technicians. Work is reviewed for compliance with accepted practices and AS9100 Quality Management Standard compliance.Essential Duties & ResponsibilitiesComply with Dryden Aeronautical Test Range (DATR) Configuration Control Board (CCB) processes, including Configuration Change Requests (CCR), System Test Reports (STR) and Discrepancy Reports (DR) to ensure accurate and timely reporting.Operate highly specialized telemetry real-time data processing and post flight processing systems in accordance with established proceduresPerform diagnostics, maintenance and repair of instrumentation/data acquisition system components, subsystems and test devices. This includes inspections, operational exercises and adjustments in accordance with specifications, drawings, manuals and established procedures.Independently work with customers and projects to develop, integrate, test, install, operate and maintain complex system of systems while maintaining high standards of workmanship while following NASA and DATR establish practices.Ability use test equipment such as: Spectrum Analyzer, O-Scope, Multimeter, Power Meter and other test equipment.Will independently perform maintenance with little to no direct supervision and will provide inputs to the customer and WGL as requiredIndependently work with customers and projects to develop, integrate, test, install, operate and maintain complex system of systems while maintaining high standards of workmanship while following NASA and DATR establish practices.Conduct pre and post flight checks and troubleshoot instrumentation/data acquisition systems to meet the flight test mission schedule.Technical familiarity with the equipment operated and maintained at the Armstrong Flight Research Center desired. Provide specialized support essential for the successful operations of mission critical facilities.Provides technical direction and performs technical tasks for all activities within WBS130.Coordinates and manages the System Operations and Maintenance Plan (SOMP) for the equipment assigned to the WBS130, including preventive and corrective maintenance.Excellent customer service skills.Will perform all essential duties and responsibilities above and provide training and technical guidance to junior-level technicians.Other Related DutiesPerform other duties as required, including supporting other work centers during surges. This may include cross training into other function areas to meet overall contract performance objectives. Perform housekeeping of the work area and equipment according to specified standards. Operate personnel lifts, Government vehicles and climb antenna towers. Troubleshoot and repair electronic and electromechanical equipment to board or assembly level. Troubleshoot networks, switches and routers. Perform display buildup, compile 'C' real-time source code and utilize command lines tools to interact with systems.QualificationsEducation and Experience:EducationMust have an associate degree in Electronics Technology or a similar field. In lieu of the associate's degree, High School graduate or High School equivalency and completion of formal training in an accredited commercial or military electronics school.ExperienceA minimum of eight years of related work experience which shall include range operations in aircraft and/or spacecraft testing.Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required For This PositionIncumbent must have a strong technical background with an emphasis on operations and maintenance of highly specialized telemetry and radar data processing systems. Operation and maintenance of telemetry hardware and cable fabrication and termination with an emphasis on electronic theory. Must have a strong technical background with an emphasis on operations, maintenance and repair of highly specialized telemetry and radar data processing systems.Core CompetenciesIn-depth knowledge of: Operations and configuring Telemetry and Radar Data Processing Systems, RF and data test equipment, telemetry antennas and tracking servo systems. Ability to work with research display applications, such as the Interactive Analysis and Display System (IADS). Fiber optics (SM & MM) and copper cable fabrication and termination. Preventive maintenance and troubleshooting procedures for Range systems. Experience with Range systems and test equipment to troubleshoot problems. Display building and programming changes in C, C# and XML. Ability to generate and compile code based on project requirements. PC hardware and software, imaging, operating systems, networking and troubleshooting.Ability to: Work under the pressure of a real-time mission environment. Configure and operate highly specialized telemetry processing systems with the ability to recognize and correctly resolve problems in time critical situations. Communicate effectively in both oral and written form; apply the principles of logical or scientific thinking to define problems, collect data and establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Establish and maintain successful working relationships with system users. Comprehend electronic formulas, drawings and schematics, analyze data and resolve problems. Work in a team environment; work under deadlines. Use a computer to input and retrieve information and data. Effectively use word processing and spreadsheet software programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, Visio and Outlook. Perform work in an ISO compliant/certified environment. Obtain and maintain a tower climbing certification. Obtain and maintain a Government security clearance. Read, write, speak and understand the English language.Work Environment, Physical And Mental DemandsProlonged sitting while using the computer, constant use of sight abilities, constant use of speech/hearing abilities for communication, constant mental alertness. Ability to work extended and flexible hours including weekends. Ability to pass a heavy equipment physical exam required to operate motorized equipment such as forklifts, bucket lifts and platform personnel lifts. Travel as required. Ability to work on aerial platforms and in an outdoor desert environment. Ability to use a computer to input and retrieve information and data.Arcata Associates is an Equal Opportunity employer. title: Software Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Code that saves lives.As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldA history of academic excellence or professional successEligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

description: Job DescriptionWhat You Will Be DoingBecome a Skunk and define the future by developing disruptive solutions that combine autonomy, stealth technology, open systems architectures, and manned/unmanned teaming capabilities to solve the most critical national security challenges today. Push the boundaries of what’s possible to quickly design, develop and test innovative solutions that provide lifesaving intelligence for the warfighter. description: We are seeking a highly innovative and adaptable Principal Data & AI Solutions Engineer to join our team at Edwards Air Force Base, CA or Nellis AFB, NV, directly supporting the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).This dynamic and evolving role offers a foundational opportunity to make a significant impact, shaping the data strategy and leveraging cutting-edge technology for a critical national defense asset. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in data engineering, advanced data visualization, and the strategic application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to empower JSE leadership and military customers with superior data-driven decision-making capabilities for system performance assessment, anomaly resolution, and warfighting capability evaluation. This individual will be a proactive champion for the introduction of cutting-edge data tools, automation strategies, and AI capabilities to significantly enhance the JSE's ability to support warfighter needs and accelerate critical test and acquisition outcomes. This role requires a self-starter capable of defining value, embracing diverse challenges, and leading data exploitation in a high-stakes defense environment. This role also requires a skilled practitioner who will be able to develop and implement solutions while a larger team is constituted. This role will navigate the complexities of vast and diverse test data generated across a distributed JSE environment, potentially spanning multiple classified networks and locations (Edwards, Nellis, Pax River, Alaska). The individual will contribute to understanding the current data landscape and architecting scalable solutions to manage ever-increasing volumes of complex data from future, more variable test events.Roles & ResponsibilitiesAI/ML Application & Innovation: Identify, prototype, and implement cutting-edge AI/Machine Learning (ML) solutions to significantly enhance JSE test data analysis and operational effectiveness. This includes developing automated identification of critical events, rapid anomaly detection (especially in high-speed data streams and real-time feeds), predictive modeling for system performance envelopes, and intelligent data querying for complex test scenarios. Leverage AI/ML to identify and track key Measures of Effectiveness (MOE) and Measures of Performance (MOP), providing automated insights into system behavior and unlocking deeper understanding of simulated system performance. Investigate and implement AI-driven solutions to automate and optimize aspects of the test planning and execution lifecycle, such as intelligent test point selection, scenario generation, and resource allocation.Advanced Dashboarding & Visualization: Lead the design, development, and implementation of intuitive, high-impact data dashboards and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, custom web applications). These solutions will translate complex JSE test data into actionable insights for JSE leadership, test aircrews, and military customers, enabling rapid, high-confidence decision-making on tactical mission performance, system-under-test behavior, threat effectiveness, and aircrew-system interaction. title: Software Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Code that saves lives.As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldA history of academic excellence or professional successEligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

title: Software Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Code that saves lives.As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldA history of academic excellence or professional successEligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

title: Senior Software Engineer (PHP & Symfony)
description: At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancerWe are professionals with purpose, beating cancer every day. But we need to go much further and much faster. Thats why were looking for someone talented, someone who wants to develop their skills, someone like you.Cancer Research UK has an ambitious Engineering Strategy and modern Tech Stack with a complex hybrid (on-premise & multi-cloud) infrastructure underpinning an extensive technical estate. As part of our Engage Strategy, the charity is delivering a range of bold, modern change initiatives and programmes to better harness our technology to deliver more engaging and positive experiences for our audiences and inspire millions of people in deeper, more meaningful ways to join our mission (and in turn drive growth).As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be part of our Fundraising & Trading portfolio, rotating across a range of change initiatives and products that helped raise 665m towards Cancer Research UK's life-saving work (e.g., our events management product, which enables mass events such as Race for Life, London Marathon, Shine, and individual events). However, you will predominantly focus on using PHP Symfony to develop the back-end of our Online Fundraising Web Application, an in-house software solution that has created half a million fundraising pages for our supporters, processed 2.6m donations, and raised c.65m for the charity. If you want to learn more about our Online Fundraising solution, check out this article from one of our Engineers working on this product.In this role, youll play a key role in advancing our Fundraising & Trading products by collaborating closely with product teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions. Youll contribute to our Engineering Strategy by writing clean, maintainable code, championing best practices, and driving technical excellence across the team.In this role, youll collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders from across the charity, including Engineers, Product Managers, Testers, Agile Coaches, Architects, and Business Analysts. Together, youll turn complex business challenges into impactful technical solutions, while continuously improving the accessibility, performance, security, and reliability of our products.Youll have the autonomy to lead the development of new features and make key technical decisions. As a senior member of the team, youll also mentor junior engineers, help shape development standards, and enhance our tooling and workflows.This is an opportunity for you to gain exposure to a modern tech stack while being part of a diverse Technology team and using your technical skills to deliver purpose-driven solutions. If youre an experienced back-end engineer with strong PHP and Symfony skills, we would love you to join our mission.What will I be doing?Delivering specific packages of development for software applications within our Fundraising & Trading Productteams andrunning these applications in production.This will involve a significant focus on the back-end creation and development of Cancer Research UKs Online Fundraising Web Application (PHP Symfony).Applying Lean and Agile principles to develop high-quality code that has minimal bugs, adheres to Cancer Research UK standards, and is highly supportable.Working either independently or in collaboration with Solution Architects to design new solutions in line with the Software Engineering strategy.Working autonomously to deliver backlog items for an existing product.Collaborating with Product Managers, Service Designers, UX Designers, Business Analysts, etc to identify user needs, discuss capabilities, and iteratively design solutions.Supporting the development of more junior Software Engineers through mentoring.What skills will I need?EssentialExperienced Software Engineer with a proven ability to write clean, readable, and properly tested code based on tried and tested design patterns.Must have demonstrable knowledge of PHP and ideally Symfony (however, were open to applicants with experience of similar PHP frameworks such as Drupal or Laravel)Some knowledge of JavaScript/ TypeScript with an ability and willingness to learn new languages, frameworks, and tools.Experience using large-scale code repositories.Some experience developing REST APIs and other back-end components.Ran critical services in production and designed highly available, scalable, and secure solutions.Awareness of accessibility standards and guidelines.Ability to communicate with technical and non-technical business colleaguesSome experience in running critical services in production and designing highly available, scalable, and secure solutions.Ideally, available to start on one months notice or less (however, were open to applicants with longer notice periods who meet all the above requirements).DesirableMeets either of the following:Acted as a Senior or Lead within an Engineering team, starting the development of new features from scratch, defining the overall solutions, and reviewing more junior engineers workSoftware Engineer with significant PHP experience who is ready for the next step up in their career, ideally with some experience in supporting and coaching colleagues and the potential to learn how to act as a Senior within the team (training will be provided if this applies).Our organisation values are designed to guide all that we do.Bold:Act with ambition, courage and determinationCredible:Act with rigour and professionalismHuman: Act to have a positive impact on peopleTogether:Act inclusively and collaborativelyWere looking for people who can package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools. title: Software Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Code that saves lives.As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related fieldA history of academic excellence or professional successEligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

title: Integration Solutions Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Make a meaningful impact by creating bridges that improve healthcare.For healthcare providers to make informed decisions and deliver the highest-quality patient care, they depend on data from niche systems across hundreds of specializations. Epic's Integration Solutions Engineers maintain that information flow across disparate systems. This group of experts tackles new challenges every day. If you seek variety in your work, you'll find it as an Integrations Solutions Engineer.As an Integration Solutions Engineer, you'll optimize the data connections critical to high-quality patient care. Alongside customer teams, you'll enhance and support integrations between Epic and external systems to ensure efficient and secure data exchanges. You'll anticipate challenges and diagnose interface issues. You'll fine-tune integrations to meet evolving operational needs in diverse healthcare settings. In doing so, you'll enable our customer's operational success, and empower them to deliver better patient care.Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planetThe top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.Bachelor's or greater in engineering, math, information systems, or a related fieldA history of academic and professional successStrong analytical and reasoning skillsEligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorshipRelocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)COVID-19 vaccinationShow moreShow less

Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. title: Principal Data & AI Solutions Engineer – Joint Simulation Environment (JSE)
description: We are seeking a highly innovative and adaptable Principal Data & AI Solutions Engineer to join our team at Edwards Air Force Base, CA or Nellis AFB, NV, directly supporting the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).This dynamic and evolving role offers a foundational opportunity to make a significant impact, shaping the data strategy and leveraging cutting-edge technology for a critical national defense asset. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in data engineering, advanced data visualization, and the strategic application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to empower JSE leadership and military customers with superior data-driven decision-making capabilities for system performance assessment, anomaly resolution, and warfighting capability evaluation. This individual will be a proactive champion for the introduction of cutting-edge data tools, automation strategies, and AI capabilities to significantly enhance the JSE's ability to support warfighter needs and accelerate critical test and acquisition outcomes. This role requires a self-starter capable of defining value, embracing diverse challenges, and leading data exploitation in a high-stakes defense environment. This role also requires a skilled practitioner who will be able to develop and implement solutions while a larger team is constituted. This role will navigate the complexities of vast and diverse test data generated across a distributed JSE environment, potentially spanning multiple classified networks and locations (Edwards, Nellis, Pax River, Alaska). The individual will contribute to understanding the current data landscape and architecting scalable solutions to manage ever-increasing volumes of complex data from future, more variable test events.Roles & ResponsibilitiesAI/ML Application & Innovation: Identify, prototype, and implement cutting-edge AI/Machine Learning (ML) solutions to significantly enhance JSE test data analysis and operational effectiveness. This includes developing automated identification of critical events, rapid anomaly detection (especially in high-speed data streams and real-time feeds), predictive modeling for system performance envelopes, and intelligent data querying for complex test scenarios. Leverage AI/ML to identify and track key Measures of Effectiveness (MOE) and Measures of Performance (MOP), providing automated insights into system behavior and unlocking deeper understanding of simulated system performance. Investigate and implement AI-driven solutions to automate and optimize aspects of the test planning and execution lifecycle, such as intelligent test point selection, scenario generation, and resource allocation.Advanced Dashboarding & Visualization: Lead the design, development, and implementation of intuitive, high-impact data dashboards and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, custom web applications). These solutions will translate complex JSE test data into actionable insights for JSE leadership, test aircrews, and military customers, enabling rapid, high-confidence decision-making on tactical mission performance, system-under-test behavior, threat effectiveness, and aircrew-system interaction. Automate data pipelines and reporting processes to ensure timely and accurate delivery of critical performance metrics and trends, excelling at understanding evolving data needs and creating compelling visualizations that reveal insights.Experimentation & Rapid Prototyping: Execute rapid prototyping efforts and proof-of-concept demonstrations for new data visualization, automation, and AI/ML capabilities. Drive iterative development cycles to quickly demonstrate value and gain stakeholder feedback for continuous improvement.Technical Advocacy & Tool Adoption: Act as the primary advocate for adopting new data tools, visualization platforms, and AI/ML technologies within the JSE. Research emerging industry trends and present compelling cases for their introduction, outlining potential benefits for data efficiency, insights generation, and overall JSE mission effectiveness.Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate directly with JSE leadership, Test Pilot School graduates, and senior military customers to understand their specific data needs.Data Quality & Governance: Support the establishment and refinement of best practices for data quality, integrity, and security across all JSE data assets. Implement robust processes for data validation, error checking, and classification to ensure the reliability of insights derived from the data. The ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to evolving data governance frameworks will be highly valued as the role grows.Team Leadership & Development: Lead, build, and grow technical teams and efforts within the JSE, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. This includes recruiting, developing via knowledge transfer, and mentoring technical talent, and establishing clear technical objectives and performance metrics for team success.ExperienceQualifications & Education:Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data science, business intelligence, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on large-scale data sets.Demonstrated expertise in designing, developing, and deploying interactive dashboards and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, or similar.Proven experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and database management (SQL, NoSQL, data lakes).Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or R, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas) and statistical analysis.Practical experience in applying AI/ML techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, natural language processing) for data analysis, pattern recognition, or predictive analytics.Experience with processing and analyzing time-series data, spectral data, and spatial data common in aerospace test environments.Ability to work in an ambiguous and evolving environment, define solutions, and articulate value propositions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to present complex data insights clearly and concisely to senior leadership.Proven aptitude for 'data storytelling' to translate analytical findings into strategic narratives.Experience in the defense or military aviation sector, with an understanding of military test and evaluation processes.Experience with data integration challenges across disparate and classified networks/systems.Experience in designing and implementing data solutions for real-time monitoring and operational decision support in high-stakes environments.Exceptional leadership and team-building capabilities.Ability to influence and persuade stakeholders at all levels.Strong business acumen and understanding of defense acquisition processes.Desired QualificationsExperience with time-series analysis, anomaly detection, deep learning for sensor data, and reinforcement learning for optimizing simulation parameters.Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hadoop).Experience with metadata management tools and data governance frameworks.Knowledge of simulation data formats and standards relevant to military aircraft testing.Exposure to control room operations or test execution environments.Understanding of aeronautical sciences, aircraft mission systems (e.g., radar, IR, EW), or flight test data.Experience with various data infrastructure deployments, including on-premise, cloud-based (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), and hybrid environments, with a strong understanding of their respective advantages and challenges for large-scale data management.EducationBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field is required.ORBachelor’s degree and relevant career experienceMaster’s degree in a relevant field is highly desired.ClearanceActive TOP SECRET clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) eligibility.Candidate must maintain a TS/SCI clearance as a condition of employment.Ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) access is required.TravelOccasional travel may be required to support customer engagements, conferences, or technology scouting title: Integration Project Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Make a meaningful impact by creating bridges that improve healthcare.For healthcare providers to make informed decisions and deliver the highest-quality patient care, they depend on data from niche systems across hundreds of specializations. Epic's Integration Project Engineers architect information flow across disparate systems. Each project presents a new set of challenges and opportunities. If you seek variety in your work, you'll find it as an Integration Project EngineerTravel across the US (and potentially abroad) as a critical member of our implementation team and ensure the early success of new Epic community members. Once you're trained up, both Epic and customer teams will look to you to advise their implementation strategy, architecture, and project management.Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planetThe top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. title: Principal Data & AI Solutions Engineer – Joint Simulation Environment (JSE)
description: We are seeking a highly innovative and adaptable Principal Data & AI Solutions Engineer to join our team at Edwards Air Force Base, CA or Nellis AFB, NV, directly supporting the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).This dynamic and evolving role offers a foundational opportunity to make a significant impact, shaping the data strategy and leveraging cutting-edge technology for a critical national defense asset. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in data engineering, advanced data visualization, and the strategic application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to empower JSE leadership and military customers with superior data-driven decision-making capabilities for system performance assessment, anomaly resolution, and warfighting capability evaluation. This individual will be a proactive champion for the introduction of cutting-edge data tools, automation strategies, and AI capabilities to significantly enhance the JSE's ability to support warfighter needs and accelerate critical test and acquisition outcomes. This role requires a self-starter capable of defining value, embracing diverse challenges, and leading data exploitation in a high-stakes defense environment. This role also requires a skilled practitioner who will be able to develop and implement solutions while a larger team is constituted. This role will navigate the complexities of vast and diverse test data generated across a distributed JSE environment, potentially spanning multiple classified networks and locations (Edwards, Nellis, Pax River, Alaska). The individual will contribute to understanding the current data landscape and architecting scalable solutions to manage ever-increasing volumes of complex data from future, more variable test events.Roles & ResponsibilitiesAI/ML Application & Innovation: Identify, prototype, and implement cutting-edge AI/Machine Learning (ML) solutions to significantly enhance JSE test data analysis and operational effectiveness. This includes developing automated identification of critical events, rapid anomaly detection (especially in high-speed data streams and real-time feeds), predictive modeling for system performance envelopes, and intelligent data querying for complex test scenarios. Leverage AI/ML to identify and track key Measures of Effectiveness (MOE) and Measures of Performance (MOP), providing automated insights into system behavior and unlocking deeper understanding of simulated system performance. Investigate and implement AI-driven solutions to automate and optimize aspects of the test planning and execution lifecycle, such as intelligent test point selection, scenario generation, and resource allocation.Advanced Dashboarding & Visualization: Lead the design, development, and implementation of intuitive, high-impact data dashboards and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, custom web applications). These solutions will translate complex JSE test data into actionable insights for JSE leadership, test aircrews, and military customers, enabling rapid, high-confidence decision-making on tactical mission performance, system-under-test behavior, threat effectiveness, and aircrew-system interaction. Automate data pipelines and reporting processes to ensure timely and accurate delivery of critical performance metrics and trends, excelling at understanding evolving data needs and creating compelling visualizations that reveal insights.Experimentation & Rapid Prototyping: Execute rapid prototyping efforts and proof-of-concept demonstrations for new data visualization, automation, and AI/ML capabilities. Drive iterative development cycles to quickly demonstrate value and gain stakeholder feedback for continuous improvement.Technical Advocacy & Tool Adoption: Act as the primary advocate for adopting new data tools, visualization platforms, and AI/ML technologies within the JSE. Research emerging industry trends and present compelling cases for their introduction, outlining potential benefits for data efficiency, insights generation, and overall JSE mission effectiveness.Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate directly with JSE leadership, Test Pilot School graduates, and senior military customers to understand their specific data needs.Data Quality & Governance: Support the establishment and refinement of best practices for data quality, integrity, and security across all JSE data assets. Implement robust processes for data validation, error checking, and classification to ensure the reliability of insights derived from the data. The ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to evolving data governance frameworks will be highly valued as the role grows.Team Leadership & Development: Lead, build, and grow technical teams and efforts within the JSE, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment. This includes recruiting, developing via knowledge transfer, and mentoring technical talent, and establishing clear technical objectives and performance metrics for team success.ExperienceQualifications & Education:Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data science, business intelligence, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on large-scale data sets.Demonstrated expertise in designing, developing, and deploying interactive dashboards and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, or similar.Proven experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and database management (SQL, NoSQL, data lakes).Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or R, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas) and statistical analysis.Practical experience in applying AI/ML techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, natural language processing) for data analysis, pattern recognition, or predictive analytics.Experience with processing and analyzing time-series data, spectral data, and spatial data common in aerospace test environments.Ability to work in an ambiguous and evolving environment, define solutions, and articulate value propositions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to present complex data insights clearly and concisely to senior leadership.Proven aptitude for 'data storytelling' to translate analytical findings into strategic narratives.Experience in the defense or military aviation sector, with an understanding of military test and evaluation processes.Experience with data integration challenges across disparate and classified networks/systems.Experience in designing and implementing data solutions for real-time monitoring and operational decision support in high-stakes environments.Exceptional leadership and team-building capabilities.Ability to influence and persuade stakeholders at all levels.Strong business acumen and understanding of defense acquisition processes.Desired QualificationsExperience with time-series analysis, anomaly detection, deep learning for sensor data, and reinforcement learning for optimizing simulation parameters.Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hadoop).Experience with metadata management tools and data governance frameworks.Knowledge of simulation data formats and standards relevant to military aircraft testing.Exposure to control room operations or test execution environments.Understanding of aeronautical sciences, aircraft mission systems (e.g., radar, IR, EW), or flight test data.Experience with various data infrastructure deployments, including on-premise, cloud-based (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), and hybrid environments, with a strong understanding of their respective advantages and challenges for large-scale data management.EducationBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field is required.ORBachelor’s degree and relevant career experienceMaster’s degree in a relevant field is highly desired.ClearanceActive TOP SECRET clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) eligibility.Candidate must maintain a TS/SCI clearance as a condition of employment.Ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) access is required.TravelOccasional travel may be required to support customer engagements, conferences, or technology scouting activities.U.S. Citizenship:Required for this Position.The pay range for this position in California is $175,000/year to $210,000/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on established Specifically, we seek to identify a candidate with expertise or willingness to learn one of the following disciplines:Aircraft stealth signature reduction and low observables (LO) phenomenologyRadar cross section (RCS) susceptibilityElectromagnetics (EM), computational electromagnetics (CEM)LO project/program managementThe candidate will be working in a high-paced environment responsible for low observable technology maturation, modeling and simulation, prototype build and test, production support, and external customer communication and marketing. The candidate will work independently and in small teams and participate in Government forums and internal Skunk Works program reviews as an emerging LO signature engineer.Typical Responsibilities May IncludeResponsible for performing, analyzing, and communicating component signature predictions using Unix-based codes and tools.Responsible for planning and/or executing laboratory measurements of material coupons to determine physical, electrical, and/or environmental properties.Engagement in the research, design, computational electromagnetic modeling, fabricating, and testing of advanced electromagnetic metamaterials.Responsible for planning, performing, post-processing, and communicating the results of laboratory, field, and component/vehicle signature measurements.Responsible for dreaming and developing new novel approaches to solve difficult problemsThe position requires strong verbal and written communication skills for final reports and technical briefings to large groups. An ability to explain complex technical concepts in a readily comprehensible manner is an advantage. The candidate should or will develop experience in customer/client interaction. This will include the ability to perceive customer needs, develop a compelling technical approach to meeting those needs, clearly and concisely describe a plan for implementing the technical approach, and provide reasonable cost/schedule estimates for the work required. The candidate will be expected to develop and execute R&D plans to meet needs defined by management or by the customer. The candidate will typically work without technical direction, but he/she may be called upon to provide technical direction for others. The candidate will participate in and ultimately lead multidisciplinary design teams to solve challenging aircraft survivability problems in the low observables, infrared signature reduction, and LO realm.Desired SkillsExperience with BOE development (previous proposal experience)Experience in the development of an integrated master schedule (IMS)Experience with Polyetherimide (PEI) foamExperience working in a production environment, specifically, process improvementsExperience using Shop Floor Manager (SFM), PEI Foam Selection tool, and working with production control (PC)Other Important InformationBy applying to this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match. Should this match be identified you may be contacted for this and future openings.Ability to work remotelyOnsite Full-time: The work associated with this position will be performed onsite at a designated Lockheed Martin facility.Show moreShow less

title: Integration Project Engineer
description: Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.Make a meaningful impact by creating bridges that improve healthcare.For healthcare providers to make informed decisions and deliver the highest-quality patient care, they depend on data from niche systems across hundreds of specializations. Epic's Integration Project Engineers architect information flow across disparate systems. Each project presents a new set of challenges and opportunities. If you seek variety in your work, you'll find it as an Integration Project EngineerTravel across the US (and potentially abroad) as a critical member of our implementation team and ensure the early success of new Epic community members. Once you're trained up, both Epic and customer teams will look to you to advise their implementation strategy, architecture, and project management.Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planetThe top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).More than just important work.Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles.
